seo.description: How the capacitive micropillar sensor turns each pulse into a calibrated blood-pressure waveform, soft, skin-worn, no ultrasound.
seo.shareDescription: Inside the soft capacitive sensor that reads beat-to-beat blood pressure from the skin.

hero.alt: How applanation tonometry reads arterial pressure through the skin
hero.title: Applanation tonometry,
hero.body: VeriTrack is built on applanation tonometry, a technique that senses the pulse of your artery right through the skin. Traditionally, this has been limited by bulky, rigid pressure sensors that struggle to conform to the body and compromise signal quality. Our core technology, soft, flexible pressure sensors, rests on the pedal artery, with its low-profile design improving the ability to measure blood pressure accurately. These measurements are then converted into continuous blood pressure, giving clinicians a complete, real-time picture of a patient’s blood pressure.

signalJourney.title: From skin contact to
signalJourney.body: Applied in under five minutes in pre-op, the VeriTrack stays in place and monitors continuously, without the placement time, complication risk, or nursing burden of an arterial line.

steps.title: Place
steps.body: A clinician applies the soft sensor over an arterial site before monitoring begins.

steps.title: Sense
steps.body: A wrinkled capacitive stack reads subtle arterial motion on every beat.

steps.title: Stream
steps.body: Streams to the bedside iPad over Bluetooth, no cables to the patient, signal confirmed before incision.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: Teams can see trends and context instead of isolated cuff snapshots.

sensingMechanism.title: Soft enough to wear.
sensingMechanism.body: At the core of VeriTrack is a soft, flexible, and stretchable pressure sensor that utilizes a proprietary wrinkled gold (wAu) thin-film process. The sensor’s gold electrodes are engineered with a controlled, micro-wrinkled surface morphology that allows them to be built on soft substrates, mechanically compatible with the human body. This compatibility lets the sensor conform seamlessly to the body’s contours and move with the skin’s natural movement, enabling improved, accurate measurements of blood pressure.

points: Wrinkled device provides 600% more surface area than traditional capacitive sensors
Micro-rigid flexibility enables advanced structures beyond the parallel plate

advantages.title: Wireless, no cables
points: Streams over Bluetooth to the bedside iPad monitor. Nothing tethered to the patient, nothing crossing the surgical field

advantages.title: Manufacturing
